This is the number three rounds never measured.

ROOT CAUSE A (the blade): every attack clip keeps the grip hand 0.63-1.35 m in front of its own root through the whole ACTIVE window, and the weapon capsule starts socket_a_dist past the hand. MIN-CONTACT is 0.50-2.71 m for player classes and 0.83-1.50 m for enemies. The blade physically cannot occupy the 0-0.5 m band in front of the attacker at any point the hitbox is live.

ROOT CAUSE A mechanism: anim-author.mjs solves swing_scale against RI-CMB04 B peak tip speed by SHRINKING the excursion about an aim pose that is arm-forward (upperarm_r.rx aim -71 deg for chop_overhead). A shrunken arc about a forward-pointing shoulder is a blade parked out front for the whole swing. The follow pose (arm down, hand at the belly) sits at phase 2.3 - AFTER the hitbox closes at phase 2.0.

ROOT CAUSE B (the lunge): separation pushes the target at a hard cap of 0.05 m/frame while a champion chop carries its root 0.8 m in 10 active frames (0.08 m/frame). The lunge outruns the push, so a target that started at 0.35 m ends up ~0.3 m inside the attacker where nothing can reach it. This is also why the separation model measures as consuming nothing.

M9 SUBSTEP — ROOT CAUSE FOUND: geometry.js sweepCapsuleVsCapsule at substeps=1 runs ONE iteration with t0=0,t1=1, i.e. it tests the FULL convex hull of the frame's motion. More substeps = a strict SUBSET of that hull. So substeps can only REMOVE false positives, never cause tunnelling misses, and M9's empty-set inference does not hold for this implementation. §sweep.substeps_are_not_a_quality_setting ('reducing them to 1 changes which attacks connect') is FALSE as written. sweep.substeps therefore has coupling 0 on an entity-side observable and this round does not claim otherwise.

R4b — THE 'ONE-FRAME PROXY CORRECTION' IN THE HAND-OFF IS WRONG, AND THE ARITHMETIC SAYS SO. cmb-exchange's f_vis is min(pose, silhouette), or the LATER of the two where they disagree by more than 4 frames. anim-author computes the POSE METRIC ONLY. Per-attack, in animation frames: chop pose 9 / sil 9 -> solver 9, gap 0. thrust pose 10 / sil 12 -> solver 9, gap 1. combo_b pose 6 / sil 5 -> solver 4, gap 1. combo_a pose 8 / sil 16, disagreement 8 > 4 so the LATER wins -> f_vis 16, solver 7, GAP 9. Tightening LIE_MAX_F from 8 to 7 fixes thrust and combo_b and CANNOT fix combo_a: it would need LIE_MAX_F = -2. The missing term is the silhouette, not a frame of slack.

R4b — SHIPPING CRASH FOUND AND FIXED, and it is why --verify had never run. game/src/engine.js:1853 called `projectNDC(camera, e.pos[0], e.pos[1]+1.2, e.pos[2], aspect)` — five scalars — against camera.js's `project(c, world[3], out[3]) -> boolean`. `out` was the number 1.2, so `out[0] = ...` threw `Cannot create property '0' on number '1.2'` out of _uiCtx, i.e. out of sim.uiDriver, i.e. out of the fixed step, ON THE FIRST FRAME AFTER LOCK-ON, browser only. `H.loadState('arena_champion'); H.lockOn('E1'); H.stepFrames(1)` reproduces it on HEAD. Locking on is the core Souls verb and it killed the frame loop. Fixed to the signature engine.js:3089 already uses; repro now returns ok.

R4b — THE 0.4561 m BOUNDARY SNAP, RE-MEASURED (browser, live trace, 1200 frames, 34 state boundaries). ROLL_RECOVER -> ATK_STARTUP is now 0.4494 m: 1.5 % better than round 3, i.e. UNCHANGED. The r4 report §11.4 hypothesis is FALSIFIED — the capsule length is 1.4180 m on BOTH sides of the boundary to four decimals, so the socket distance does not change. Root translation is 0.0000 m and yaw delta is 0.00 deg. Both sockets move +0.4431 m and +0.4479 m in Y and essentially nothing in X or Z: it is a WHOLE-RIG VERTICAL TRANSLATION. Cause: `roll_ground.root_offset.y` is about -0.44 at the phase the roll was interrupted at, the incoming attack clip starts at 0, and `clips.json §cross_fade.what_it_blends` excludes root motion BY DECLARATION ('the per-bone Euler pose, and nothing else'). The blend cannot touch the one term that is the entire residual.

R4b — a WORSE single-frame tip move than any boundary in the round-3 table: ROLL_STARTUP -> ROLL_IFRAME, 0.6237 m @f4, same anim (roll_light), root moving 0.2133 m, so 0.406 m of it is the blade's own motion inside the roll.
